text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
“—Managed to slip out of the classroom, I 
did! Cleaning duty is far too troublesome, 
after all!”

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Spending time on that... Sword fighting 
would be vastly more productive!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm! 100 practice swings facing the window 
today as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SHATTERRR!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Hello, is this No Reason-san?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Right now, I am looking over the 
equipment report compiled by the General 
Affairs Committee.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Damaged cleaning supplies: No Reason." 
"Damaged school windowpane: No Reason." 
...Care to share the details on this?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I am so sorry! My hands are full right 
now...! Could you come to the central 
plaza for me?!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Zariro! Why must you always go 
there...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-san... and Furioso-san? Whatever 
is the matter?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Ikuno-dono! This one's pet often 
takes refuge right beneath the Goddess 
Statue.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Just recently, the exact same thing 
happened to me, y'know~ Good grief!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Um... previously, No Reason-san also tried 
over and over again to scoop it up with a 
broom...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Her shears can cut through anything. If 
I'm not careful, my broom will be chopped 
to pieces!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ――...I see.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hold on just a moment~! I'll save ye right 
now~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Oryaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
C-Crawdaddy...! Thank you so much, No 
Reason-san!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha~!! I am glad things went so 
swimmingly!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the broom—I see how it is. Now, 
as for the windowpane—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The windowpane I noticed had a 
particularly nasty crack in it, you see. 
Thinking it would be dangerous to leave as 
is――

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I broke it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: D-Did she just split it...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Strong winds were forecast for that day! 
Come on, think carefully about it!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There's a risk of glass shards flying 
everywhere, isn't there! In that case—it's 
better to break it first!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Every second counted— Thinking of the 
other students... I picked up the stick!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What is it?! Did you find something 
strange?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I'm sorry. ...I was just thinking 
what an extraordinary, unpredictable 
person you are."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood in full. I will handle the rest 
of the processing here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing training, I handed No 
Reason a certain item.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a letter from Ikuno-dono! Heheheh, so 
it's a get-out-of-jail-free card, thenâ

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: What in the world is this~?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"‘I was deeply moved by your generosity. 
It makes me brace myself to work even 
harder.’"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"By the way, once your written apology is 
complete, please bring it to me. (P.S.) I 
shall accompany you when you submit it to 
the Academy."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Wait... This isn't what I plaaanned! My 
scheme to get off the hook with a sympathy 
play is completely rooined~~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
W-Why meow?! I thought everything was 
going so smoothly!
choice_data_list: This is all out of care for No Reason too.

Could it be that they saw right through 
everything?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I'll accompany you when submitting it to 
the academy"...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!! If that's how it is, I'll write an 
apology letter so stunning it'll blow 
everyone away!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Impossible! My perfect plan was...?!
choice_data_list:
Wasn't going through the window glass 
pushing it a bit?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Aaargh!! If that's how it's gonna be, 
I'll write an apology letter so 
magnificent it'll blow their minds!
